subject: FortifyLink integration: secure evidence exchange & pen-test orchestration

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@fortifylink.io>

Cc: tom.reynolds@fortifylink.io, procurement@fortifylink.io
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FortifyLink -> Redwood: evidence sync & pen-test integration (SOW attached)

Hi Lauren / Marcus,

Thanks for the intro. FortifyLink has a small set of customers using our GRC adapter to pull SOC2 artifacts and pen-test outputs into a consolidated workspace. We think there’s a good fit to build a managed evidence sync that plugs into Redwood’s Dedicated/Private customers and automates transfer + audit logging.

Attached is a first-draft SOW (FortifyLink_SOW_v1.pdf) that outlines scope, timelines, and a basic security posture (we propose a two-stage rollout: sandbox connector -> pilot customer -> general availability). A few things we want to confirm from Redwood before we schedule a scoping call:

- Preferred secure transport: presigned S3 uploads vs. SFTP vs. VPN-mounted archive?
- Minimum evidence retention and redaction rules you require for third-party ingestion.
- Whether Redwood can whitelist a FortifyLink IP range for short-lived transfer windows.

We can be flexible on the transport; happy to shape to your ops model. Can you share 30-45 minutes next week for a scoping call? Proposed slots: Tue 7/6 10-11am PT, Wed 7/7 2-3pm PT.

Thanks,

Aisha Khan
Director, Integrations | FortifyLink
Attachments: FortifyLink_SOW_v1.pdf
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@fortifylink.io>

Subject: Re: FortifyLink -> Redwood: evidence sync & pen-test integration (SOW attached)

On Wed, Jun 30, 2027 at 09:12 AM Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@fortifylink.io> wrote:
> Thanks for the intro. FortifyLink has a small set of customers using our GRC adapter to pull SOC2 artifacts and pen-test outputs into a consolidated workspace.

Hi Aisha — great to meet you. Thanks for the SOW; Marcus and I reviewed it quickly. High level: we like the staged rollout approach. A few notes before the kickoff so we can scope the pilot properly:

- Transport: Redwood’s preference for hosted/Dedicated customers is presigned S3 uploads to a customer-controlled bucket with short TTL presigned URLs. For Private deployments we can support a VPN-backed transfer or scoped SCP.
- Evidence handling: we require sha256 checksums and an audit log entry per ingest.
- Keys: we need to confirm whether FortifyLink will manage encryption keys or if you can push to our KMS/HSM.

Rishi — looping you in for security requirements and any redlines on the SOW. Sergio — please own the procurement path and DocuSign flow (we’ll need PO template + any standard MSA changes).

I can do Tue 7/6 10am PT. Marcus / Aisha — does that work for you?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0198
Attachments referenced: FW-Scope-questions.xlsx (internal scoping worksheet)
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@fortifylink.io>

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FortifyLink -> Redwood: evidence sync & pen-test integration (SOW attached)

Thanks Lauren — Tue 7/6 10am PT works for me and Tom. We’ve started filling the scoping worksheet and attached a small roles CSV (PenTest_Roles.csv) that maps the artefact producers to FortifyLink ingestion tags. A few clarifications up front:

- We can support presigned S3 or SFTP. For Private deployments we typically recommend a VPN + mutual TLS for the initial sync, then switch to presigned uploads for ongoing transfers.
- We do not manage customer KMS keys by default; we can support using your KMS if you provide a grant workflow or an STS role.
- FortifyLink will keep copies of ingested metadata for indexing but we can configure zero-copy flows for raw artifacts if required by customer policy.

We’ll bring engineering and our security lead to the call to walk the data flow. See you Tuesday.

Aisha
Director, Integrations | FortifyLink
Attachments: PenTest_Roles.csv
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@fortifylink.io>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FortifyLink -> Redwood: evidence sync & pen-test integration (SOW attached)

Aisha / team — quick security requirements ahead of the scoping call so we have the right stakeholders: 

Required by Redwood Security for any partner ingest pipeline:
- Vendor must complete our Vendor Security Form: Vendor_Security_Form_2027.pdf (attached).
- Data-in-transit: TLS1.2+ and mutual auth for automated sync. For presigned S3 flows we require server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) and a documented KMS key policy.
- Audit logs: ingest operations must emit an immutable audit record with actor, timestamp, objectChecksum, and sourceIP. Logs must be available for 90 days in our audit index.
- Evidence retention policy: by default customers may request 365-day retention; FortifyLink must support per-customer retention controls and on-demand deletions with proof of deletion.
- Pen-test artifacts: any PII must be redacted before FortifyLink indexes or extracts findings.

If FortifyLink can confirm these items prior to the call it will speed the pilot approval. I’ll be on the call Tuesday and can bring the compliance folks if needed.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Assurance | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Vendor_Security_Form_2027.pdf
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: FortifyLink integration — summary & next steps

Team — quick summary from our side and action items following the scoping call today: 

What we agreed:
- Pilot flow: VPN-backed sync into a sandbox bucket for one pilot customer, then presigned S3 for GA.
- FortifyLink will support SSE-KMS and provide an STS role grant template for KMS access.
- FortifyLink to complete Vendor_Security_Form_2027.pdf and provide redline to SOW by EOD Friday 7/9.
- Audit/logging: FortifyLink will emit checksum+actor+sourceIP on ingest; Redwood will pull logs via a short-term log export endpoint.

Action items (owners):
- FortifyLink (Aisha/Tom): return completed Vendor_Security_Form_2027.pdf; redline SOW; provide staging VPN details (by 2027-07-09).
- Redwood Security (Rishi): review completed vendor form and confirm retention controls; provide KMS grant template (by 2027-07-11).
- Partner Ops (Sergio): prepare PO and DocuSign MSA routing; share HubSpot deal record and PO template.
- Partnerships (Lauren/Marcus): coordinate pilot customer selection and success criteria.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/companies/1234567), SOW draft in Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cFortifyDrive), DocuSign envelope (https://na1.docusign.net/Signing/?env=na1&acct=ABCD1234).

Thanks everyone — let’s close the SOW and vendor form this week so engineering can stand up the sandbox connector next week.

Best,
